decision: Drive through penalty. (20 seconds added to elapsed Sprint/Race time).
fact: Entering the pits during a Safety Car period and not changing tyres.
offence: Breach of Article 55.11 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty. (20 seconds added to elapsed Sprint/Race time).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 20 (Kevin Magnussen), team representative and reviewed video evidence and determined that Car 20 entered the pit lane during the safety car period and did not change tyres as required under Article 55.11 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The team admitted that this was an error on their part. While there was no precedent for this particular infringement, in order to remain consistent with other infringements of Article 55.11 of the Sporting Regulations, we impose a drive through penalty.
rules_referenced: Article 55.11 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 20 Entering Pit Lane Under Safety Car Conditions
